text.text: Hold right-click, then release to throw. The longer you charge, the faster and harder the throw.
Throwing knives, axes and javelins come in stacks. Like Tinkers arrows,
the number of projectiles comes from the durability of the materials
Pick your projectiles back up: they return to an identical stack. Each hit wears them down, and an empty stack stays in your inventory until you refill it.
